{d q : ℕ} (κ : ℝ) (hκ : 2 ≤ κ) (hq : 2 * q + 1 < d)
    (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d × Fin (q + 1))) :
  let θ : Fin d → ℝ := fun i => ((i.val : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * Real.pi / (d : ℝ)
  let eigenvalue : Fin d → ℝ := fun i => (κ + 1) / 2 + (κ - 1) / 2 * Real.cos (θ i)
  let Λ : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ := Matrix.diagonal eigenvalue
  let g : Fin (q + 1) → Fin d → ℝ := fun a i => WithLp.ofLp x (i, a)
  let t : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin (q + 1)) ℝ := fun i k =>
    if k.val = 0 then 1 else Real.sqrt 2 * Real.cos ((k.val : ℝ) * θ i)
  let B : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) ℝ := fun i a =>
    (Real.sqrt (d : ℝ))⁻¹ * g a.1 i * t i a.2
  let K : Submodule ℝ (Fin d → ℝ) :=
    Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range (fun a : Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1) =>
      (Λ ^ a.2.val).mulVec (g a.1)))
  let D : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ :=
    Matrix.diagonal (fun i => Real.cos (((2 * q + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * θ i))
  ∀ v : Fin d → ℝ, v ∈ K →
    ∃ c : Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1) → ℝ,
      B.mulVec c = v ∧
      ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))‖ ^ 2 =
        (∑ a : Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1), c a * ((B.transpose * B).mulVec c) a) ∧
      (inner ℝ (WithLp.toLp 2 v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))
        (WithLp.toLp 2 (D.mulVec v) : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))) =
        (∑ a : Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1), c a * ((B.transpose * D * B).mulVec c) a)

minimal_definitions.context: Set.range is the actual existential image; arbitrary real coefficient functions, not a supplied span/range certificate.
minimal_definitions.literal: def range (f : ι → α) : Set α := {x | ∃ y, f y = x}

minimal_definitions.context: Submodule namespace; fixed ℝ module of functions Fin d → ℝ. General context Semiring R, AddCommMonoid M, Module R M; no norm chosen by span.
minimal_definitions.literal:
def span (s : Set M) : Submodule R M :=
  sInf { p | s ⊆ p }

minimal_definitions.context: The ambient index m is finite. Fixed real scalar multiplication/addition in the target.
minimal_definitions.literal:
def dotProduct [Mul α] [AddCommMonoid α] (v w : m → α) : α :=
  ∑ i, v i * w i

minimal_definitions.context: Matrix namespace; NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring α. Both fixed finite matrix multiplication and vector products use ordinary sums.
minimal_definitions.literal:
def mulVec [Fintype n] (M : Matrix m n α) (v : n → α) : m → α
  | i => (fun j => M i j) ⬝ᵥ v

minimal_definitions.context: Matrix namespace; decidable equality on finite indices, fixed real zero. Matrix powers are ordinary Nat powers in the canonical finite real matrix semiring, not entrywise powers.
minimal_definitions.literal:
def diagonal [Zero α] (d : n → α) : Matrix n n α :=
  of fun i j => if i = j then d i else 0

minimal_definitions.context: The literal constructor named toLp and projection ofLp identify the underlying values; this is not a norm-preserving claim about the raw function supremum norm.
minimal_definitions.literal:
structure WithLp (p : ℝ≥0∞) (V : Type*) where
  /-- Converts an element of `V` to an element of `WithLp p V`. -/
  toLp (p) ::
  /-- Converts an element of `WithLp p V` to an element of `V`. -/
  ofLp : V

minimal_definitions.context: PiLp 2 supplies the L2 product structure.
minimal_definitions.literal:
abbrev PiLp (p : ℝ≥0∞) {ι : Type*} (α : ι → Type*) : Type _ :=
  WithLp p (∀ i : ι, α i)

minimal_definitions.context: Fixed real scalars and finite indices. Actual norm and inner product in the consumer are those of EuclideanSpace, with WithLp.toLp shown explicitly.
minimal_definitions.literal:
abbrev EuclideanSpace (𝕜 : Type*) (n : Type*) : Type _ :=
  PiLp 2 fun _ : n => 𝕜

instance (p : ℝ≥0∞) {ι : Type*} (α : ι → Type*) : CoeFun (PiLp p α) (fun _ ↦ (i : ι) → α i) where
  coe := ofLp

context: local notation "⟪" x ", " y "⟫" => inner 𝕜 x y
minimal_definitions.literal:
theorem inner_eq_star_dotProduct (x y : EuclideanSpace 𝕜 ι) :
    ⟪x, y⟫ = ofLp y ⬝ᵥ star (ofLp x)
